candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that credits the deposited amount to the caller's balance, so Deposit no longer changes balances.
Credit twice the deposited value instead of the deposited value, so balances differ after any deposit.
Change the guard from >= to > so deposits of exactly MinDeposit no longer update balances.
Insert an extra statement crediting 1 wei after the normal balance update, so balances differ after any successful deposit.
Change the guard from `msg.value >= MinDeposit` to `msg.value > MinDeposit`, so a deposit of exactly 1 ether no longer credits the sender.
Delete the balance update statement so deposits are logged but never credited.
Change `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` to `balances[msg.sender]-=msg.value;`, causing deposits to subtract (and revert on underflow) instead of add.
Delete the AddMessage call so a deposit no longer records an entry in the Log History.
Delete the TransferLog.AddMessage(msg.sender,_am,"CashOut") statement so successful CashOut calls are never recorded in the log.
Log a value of 0 instead of _am in AddMessage so the recorded Val for a CashOut differs.
Change the logged data string from "CashOut" to "Withdraw" so the recorded Data field for a CashOut differs.
Log the contract's own address instead of msg.sender so the recorded Sender field for a CashOut differs.

Move the AddMessage call outside the success check so it also executes (after the revert check fails) on reverted... actually record before the external call, changing which messages are appended when the call reverts.
